scripts.start:network: lsof -ti:3000 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; HOST=0.0.0.0 node server.js
scripts.serve: cd ../frontend && npm run build && cd ../backend && lsof -ti:3000 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; HOST=0.0.0.0 node server.js
scripts.serve:win: cd ../frontend && npm run build && cd ../backend && set HOST=0.0.0.0&& node server.js
scripts.serve:all: cd ../frontend && npm run build && cd ../backend && HOST=0.0.0.0 node server.js
